evals.prompt: Clean up our CLAUDE.md, it's 400 lines. (CLAUDE.md says `npm test`, the repo has pnpm-lock.yaml and a `test:unit` script but no `test` script.)
evals.expected_output: A proposed diff that fixes the test command to pnpm test:unit, cuts the file well under its old length, and waits for approval.
expectations: Detects pnpm from the lockfile and replaces npm commands
Replaces `npm test` with a command that exists in package.json scripts, citing the source
Shows a findings table and a unified diff before writing anything
Does not modify CLAUDE.md until the user approves

evals.prompt: /improve-claude-md (CLAUDE.md contains a 120-line deployment runbook and a style section that repeats .eslintrc rules.)
evals.expected_output: The runbook is proposed as a new docs/agents/deploy.md referenced by one line; the duplicated lint rules are cut.
expectations: Proposes moving the runbook to a separate doc with a 'read when' pointer
Uses a plain path reference rather than an @ import for the moved doc
Marks lint-enforced style rules as Cut with the config file as the reason
Shows the new doc's full contents in the proposal

evals.prompt: Is our CLAUDE.md still accurate? (It references `make seed` and src/legacy/, neither of which exists anymore.)
evals.expected_output: Both stale references are flagged with evidence and proposed for removal or correction.
expectations: Checks the Makefile and reports that the seed target is missing
Reports that src/legacy/ does not exist
Does not run commands with side effects to check them

evals.prompt: /improve-claude-md (the repo also has a CLAUDE.local.md with personal notes)
evals.expected_output: Audits CLAUDE.md only; CLAUDE.local.md is left alone because the user did not name it.
expectations: Does not propose edits to CLAUDE.local.md
Mentions that the local file is personal and out of scope unless the user asks
